title: Andrew Morgan falling asleep and taking over John Casimir's band

blocks.x: Well, what about Morgan? Did you ever play with Andrew Morgan? Andrew? Oh yeah, I played with Thomas. Oh yeah?

Yeah, yeah, I played with Andrew. Andrew played with Thomas. Uh huh. Plenty of time I had to kick him on the feet for sitting up there sleeping. Oh, he's a big sleeper. Uh huh. Andrew sat up there with his horn in his mouth and going fast asleep. While the band playing, sometime I had to kick him on the feet to make him wake up.
Well, was he working hard in those days? Huh? Was he working hard during the day or what?

No, I don't know, just like, I don't know, just go to sleep like that, that's all I can sleep. I met him about uh, I met Andrew about two weeks ago. Tell me he can't do that walking much no more in the band. No, he's got a bad, bad back. Yeah, he told me, say, uh, he uh, gets in the car and rides some and then he'd get out and walk a little bit and get back in the car again. Yeah. Yeah, he told me, he told me he can't do all that walking no more. And now he makes movies. Huh?

He's got a movie camera now. Yeah. So between the automobile and the movie, he never plays. Can you imagine? He makes movies of his own band and still playing. Yeah, that's a nice old fellow here, see.
Well, you see, Andrew took over the band after Kazmi died, you see, Kazmi used to lead that band, John. Yeah. Well, after John died, well, Andrew took the band over.
